name: paginationTest
description: Tests the pagination functionality in the 'Categories' section. It validates navigation across pages, ensures results differ between pages, and checks the 'Next' and 'Previous' buttons.

steps.name: Click on the Mountain Resorts button
Wait until the Mountain Resorts page reloads
Get texts of offers on the first page
Wait until the Mountain Resorts page reloads
Click on the next arrow to navigate to the next page
Wait until the Mountain Resorts page reloads
Validate page navigation to the next page
Get texts of offers on the second page
Validate that results on the second page differ from the first page
Click on the previus arrow to navigate to the previus page
Wait until the Mountain Resorts page reloads
Validate pagination buttons' click and background color
